maker: Galaxea Dynamics (GALAXEA (Beijing) Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd.)
name: Galaxea NEXO
summary: Galaxea's flagship wheeled dual-arm humanoid (1.7 m, 30 force-controlled DOF) with 20 kg peak dual-arm payload, 2.5 m/s travel speed and 24/7 operation, aimed at manufacturing, logistics and retail work.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. NEXO is not in Galaxea's international store (which ships to Germany) or on RBTX; the maker page only offers 'Get a Quote' with a Chinese phone number.

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: the maker page says standby runtime; the launch news says battery life
specs.quote: NEXO offers eight hours of battery life and supports continuous 24/7 operations

specs.label: Perception
specs.value: 8 MP 4K monocular RGB, fisheye and depth cameras, dual lidar
specs.quote: Industry-first 8MP 4K vision for powerful environmental perception

notes: Galaxea calls NEXO a 'Next-Generation Flagship Wheeled Dual-Arm Humanoid Robot'.
The 20 kg is a peak figure for both arms together; no per-arm or rated payload is given.
The DOF count includes end effectors, but their type (gripper or hand) is not stated.

evidence.task: E-commerce and retail, industrial manufacturing, express delivery and logistics, commercial services
evidence.note: Shown at Galaxea's forum during the 2026 World Robot Conference; no construction use reported.

sources.title: Galaxea at the 2026 World Robot Conference
